main.description: An owner of the context puts something to the vote. The poll gets a place in the tree under `parent_id`. Who may vote is frozen here: every member of the context who holds voting rights at this moment. A secret poll's issuer key is made here and published with the poll, before any ballot.

parent_id.description: The motion, amendment, question or position put to the vote.

question.description: The wording voted on, fixed for the life of the poll. The title if absent.

options.description: A ballot records an option's INDEX, so the order is part of the poll. `for`, `against` and `blank` are markers the client translates; anything else is shown as written.

blank.description: The LAST option is the abstention: chosen alone or not at all, and never the winner.

hide_tally.description: The counts, and a secret poll's board, are for the owners of the context. The turnout is still everyone's.

public_board.description: Whether a secret poll's board is published, on a site that has a board account, for anyone to read and mirror. Absent, it is where the context is open to everyone: a board tells the world what a vote came to, which a closed group's members have to themselves. Refused with `hide_tally`, and for a poll that is not secret, which has no board.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such context, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not an owner of the context.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: No such parent, a parent that is not put to votes, or ballot rules that cannot be met.

errors.name: NoVoters
errors.description: Nobody in the context holds voting rights (HTTP 409).
